issues.where: the dark foreground ledges along the bottom edge
issues.what: the ledge faces melt into long glossy black and olive streaks with the same wavy profile repeated across steps; they read as stretched material rather than erosion or runoff
issues.fix: give the ledges broken stone geometry and granular texture; confine wet streaks to irregular runoff paths

issues.where: the shallow water across both crops, particularly behind the legs on the right
issues.what: long, straight black gaps and pale strips split the shallows into separate sheets just in front of the breaking wave
issues.fix: join the shoaling water into one continuous surface and break the shore edge with uneven run-up, foam, and wet rock

issues.where: the flock on the center and right terraces, clearest in set-B-03.png at left
issues.what: the same tucked head, ribbed wing silhouette and dry beige surface repeat across adjacent ledges, making the colony look like rows of copies
issues.fix: vary poses, wing folds, body shapes, and local wetness or staining; place each animal individually on its ledge

issues.where: the close cliff in the lower-left crop
issues.what: orange and gray texture stretches into ribbons over sharply faceted faces and changes direction abruptly at mesh edges
issues.fix: break up the facets and use scale-consistent stone detail that wraps over the ledge edges without stretching

issues.where: the exposed head near the bottom left of the right-hand crop
issues.what: a distinct dark oval in the eye position reads as an eye on the otherwise eyeless animal
issues.fix: remove the eye-like recess and contrast while retaining continuous skin detail across the head

issues.where: where the right-hand animal's legs enter the shallows
issues.what: the reflected legs meet the real legs at sharp mirrored elbows, without a visible foot, meniscus, or ripple to establish contact
issues.fix: show the feet through the shallow water with refraction and add small contact ripples that disturb the reflection

issues.where: the left wall above the waterline and the rock below the wing
issues.what: large parts of the wall go nearly pure black except for disconnected blue-gray glints, making the wet rock look lacquered under the bright sky and surf
issues.fix: restore bounce light and diffuse rock detail in shadow, and vary wet specular response by surface angle and roughness

issues.where: the center of the breaker in the upper-right crop
issues.what: hard white spray flecks stand in front of a mostly uniform gray veil, with little depth or directional light connecting the two
issues.fix: grade the mist by thickness and depth, and blend the spray into the breaking crest with a range of droplet sizes and light response
